properties.title: BAM Fisher opened in Fort Greene
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Academy of Music records BAM Fisher opening in September 2012 as a new performance and rehearsal facility.
properties.explanation: A new performing arts building entered use around BAM's Brooklyn cultural campus.

properties.title: Barclays Center opened in Brooklyn
properties.short_description: Barclays Center opened to the public at the Atlantic Yards/Pacific Park site in Brooklyn.
properties.explanation: A new arena entered use at the intersection of Downtown Brooklyn, Fort Greene, and Prospect Heights.

properties.title: Bronx Community College North Hall and Library completed
properties.short_description: Bronx Community College's 2012-2014 President's Report records North Hall and Library as completed in September 2012 and celebrated with a formal ribbon-cutting ceremony.
properties.explanation: A new academic building and library entered campus use on the University Heights campus.

properties.title: Brooklyn Botanic Garden Visitor Center opened
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Botanic Garden opened its new Visitor Center on Washington Avenue in May 2012.
properties.explanation: A new visitor building and garden threshold entered use at Brooklyn Botanic Garden.

properties.title: Brooklyn Bridge Park Pier 5 opened
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Bridge Park records Mayor Bloomberg opening Pier 5 on 11 December 2012 with sports fields and a picnic peninsula.
properties.explanation: A former shipping pier entered use as active waterfront recreation space with sports fields and picnic facilities.

properties.title: Claire Tow Theater opened at Lincoln Center
properties.short_description: Lincoln Center Theater materials and venue records document the Claire Tow Theater opening in June 2012.
properties.explanation: A rooftop theater for new work entered use above the Vivian Beaumont Theater at Lincoln Center.

properties.title: Classic Playground basketball courts reopened after reconstruction
properties.short_description: NYC Parks recorded an August 7, 2012 ribbon cutting for reconstructed basketball courts at Classic Playground in Van Cortlandt Park.
properties.explanation: Two public basketball courts at Classic Playground returned to documented use after reconstruction of pavement, backboards, court lines, benches, and storm-drain cleaning.

properties.title: CUNY School of Law opened its Long Island City home
properties.short_description: CUNY School of Law recorded a ribbon-cutting on 22 October 2012 to mark the opening of its new home at 2 Court Square in Long Island City.
properties.explanation: A law school moved into a new dedicated Long Island City building with classrooms, library, clinical, and student spaces.

properties.title: East 10th Street Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission map materials record the East 10th Street Historic District, LP-2492, as designated on January 17, 2012.
properties.explanation: A documented heritage-designation status change was recorded for the named site.

properties.title: East Village/Lower East Side Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: The LPC designation report records the East Village/Lower East Side Historic District designation on October 9, 2012, adding a formal preservation boundary for part of Lower Manhattan's built fabric.
properties.explanation: A documented heritage-designation status change was recorded for the named site.

properties.title: BMCC Fiterman Hall reopened as a replacement building
properties.short_description: BMCC records the rebuilt Fiterman Hall opening for its first day of classes on 27 August 2012 after the original building was damaged beyond repair on September 11, 2001.

properties.title: FDR Four Freedoms State Park opened to the public
properties.short_description: New York State Parks records Franklin D. Roosevelt Four Freedoms State Park opening to the public on 24 October 2012.

properties.title: Guttman Community College opened its Midtown vertical campus

properties.title: Harlem Hospital Mural Pavilion opened
properties.short_description: NYC Health + Hospitals records a 27 September 2012 ribbon-cutting that marked completion of the main construction phase and opening of the Harlem Hospital Center Mural Pavilion.

properties.title: New Settlement Community Campus opened on Jerome Avenue
properties.short_description: New Settlement records the Jerome Avenue community campus opening in September 2012 with schools, community facilities, a pool, studios, gallery, amphitheater, and rooftop garden terrace.

properties.title: Pershing Square Signature Center opened
properties.short_description: BroadwayWorld reported Signature Theatre opening the Frank Gehry-designed Pershing Square Signature Center on 31 January 2012.
properties.explanation: A new three-theatre Off-Broadway complex entered public performance, rehearsal, cafe, bookstore, and office use on West 42nd Street.

properties.title: The Public Theater reopened after revitalization
properties.short_description: Project records describe the Public Theater opening a major revitalization of its landmark Lafayette Street home in fall 2012.

properties.title: Via Verde officially opened in the South Bronx

properties.title: WNYC Transmitter Park opened to the public
properties.short_description: A New York City environmental assessment statement records that the 2.2-acre WNYC Transmitter Park in Greenpoint opened to the public in 2012.
